turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting resistance welding electrode diagnostic and qualification procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the following visual checks: First, inspect the electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than one millimeter or any mushrooming. Second, check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. Third, inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Visual inspection complete. The electrode caps show minor surface wear but no deep pitting or mushrooming. The shank surfaces are clean with no corrosion, and both coolant ports are clear.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is there electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The electrode caps look okay, but I'm seeing significant discoloration and heat marks on the electrode shank itself, not just the cap.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the caps are in serviceable condition with only minor wear marks.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the electrode face diameter within wear limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The electrode face looks okay size-wise, but I'm seeing some weird pitting and discoloration on the shank where it connects to the holder - like it's been arcing or overheating at the connection point.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the measured face diameter is still above the minimum serviceable dimension.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both electrodes are showing flow rates well above the minimum spec.

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the electrode force within plus or minus five percent of the programmed schedule value?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the measured force is reading about eight percent low on the load cell.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the pneumatic pressure regulator on the electrode arm to bring the force into specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust pneumatic pressure regulator on electrode arm

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Regulator adjustment complete. I've increased the pressure setting to compensate.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust pneumatic pressure regulator on electrode arm

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify electrode force after regulator adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify electrode force after regulator adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Hey, before I finish this check, do you know if we're supposed to submit a separate work order for the cooling system maintenance that's coming due next week?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Force is now within tolerance, reading two percent above target.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify electrode force after regulator adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the measured weld current within plus or minus three percent of the scheduled value?

ground_truth.node_text: Measured weld current within ±3% of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the peak current on the test weld is reading about five percent below schedule.

ground_truth.node_text: Measured weld current within ±3% of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Access the weld controller parameter menu using the maintenance password. Read the current correction factor for the affected welding schedule and compare the stored factor against the reference value for this material stack.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Access the weld controller parameter menu using the maintenance password. 2. Read the current correction factor for the affected welding schedule. 3. Compare the stored factor against the reference value for this material stack.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've accessed the controller and adjusted the correction factor to match the reference value for this material.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Access the weld controller parameter menu using the maintenance password. 2. Read the current correction factor for the affected welding schedule. 3. Compare the stored factor against the reference value for this material stack.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify weld current after controller correction.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify weld current after controller correction

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Current is now within spec, reading one percent below nominal.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify weld current after controller correction

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the weld time within plus or minus one cycle of the scheduled value?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld time within ±1 cycle of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the measured weld time matches the programmed value within half a cycle.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld time within ±1 cycle of scheduled value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the electrode faces parallel, with contact pattern above ninety percent of face area?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above 90% of face area?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the carbon transfer pattern shows full concentric contact across both electrode faces.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode faces parallel, contact pattern above 90% of face area?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the pilot weld appearance show no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

ground_truth.node_text: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing some minor spatter around the weld perimeter on a couple of the test coupons.

ground_truth.node_text: Pilot weld appearance, no spatter, expulsion or surface cracks?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the weld schedule by modifying current and force for the material batch to eliminate the spatter.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust weld schedule, modify current and force for material batch

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Schedule adjusted. I've reduced the current slightly and increased the force to improve consolidation.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust weld schedule, modify current and force for material batch

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Apply ultrasonic couplant to each pilot weld coupon and scan the weld zone using the A-scan probe. Record the signal amplitude and back wall echo, identify the nugget boundary, and measure the diameter. Compare your measurements against the minimum nugget diameter in the quality specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply ultrasonic couplant to the electrode face side of each pilot weld coupon and scan the weld zone using an A scan ultrasonic probe. Record the reflected signal amplitude and the back wall echo attenuation. Identify the nugget boundary and measure the nugget diameter from the scan image. Compare against the minimum nugget diameter in the weld quality specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Ultrasonic scan complete. All five coupons show clear nugget boundaries and the diameters are recorded in the log.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply ultrasonic couplant to the electrode face side of each pilot weld coupon and scan the weld zone using an A scan ultrasonic probe. Record the reflected signal amplitude and the back wall echo attenuation. Identify the nugget boundary and measure the nugget diameter from the scan image. Compare against the minimum nugget diameter in the weld quality specification.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the weld nugget diameter meet minimum for material thickness?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all nugget diameters are above the minimum requirement for this material stack.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld nugget diameter meets minimum for material thickness?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Does the peel test show button pull failure mode with no interfacial fracture?

ground_truth.node_text: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

turns.utterance: No, two of the samples are showing partial interfacial fracture instead of full button pull.

ground_truth.node_text: Peel test shows button pull failure mode, no interfacial fracture?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Revise the weld schedule by increasing heat input incrementally to achieve better fusion.

ground_truth.node_text: Revise weld schedule, increase heat input incrementally

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Schedule revised. I've increased the weld current by two percent and extended the weld time by one cycle.

ground_truth.node_text: Revise weld schedule, increase heat input incrementally

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify peel test result after schedule revision.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify peel test result after schedule revision

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Peel test is now passing. All samples show full button pull with good nugget diameter.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify peel test result after schedule revision

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Has the weld controller backup completed successfully?

ground_truth.node_text: Weld controller backup completed successfully?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the schedule file transferred to the server without error and the timestamp is current.

ground_truth.node_text: Weld controller backup completed successfully?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the coolant return temperature within rated range?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within rated range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the return temperature is running about five degrees above the maximum rated value.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Check the chiller setpoint and clean the condenser to bring the coolant temperature back into range.

ground_truth.node_text: Check chiller setpoint and clean condenser

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Chiller setpoint verified and condenser cleaned. Temperature is now dropping back to normal range.

ground_truth.node_text: Check chiller setpoint and clean condenser

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Run twenty consecutive production welds at the standard schedule settings. Log the weld current, force, and time for each weld from the controller output. Inspect the final five weld spots visually for consistent button size and absence of surface expulsion before signing off the qualification record.

ground_truth.node_text: Run 20 consecutive production welds at the standard schedule settings with the machine in normal production configuration. Log the weld current, weld force, and weld time for each weld from the controller weld data output. Inspect the final five weld spots visually for consistent button size and absence of surface expulsion before signing off the qualification record.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Production qualification run complete. All twenty welds logged and the final five spots look consistent with no defects.

ground_truth.node_text: Run 20 consecutive production welds at the standard schedule settings with the machine in normal production configuration. turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all production qualification welds within specification?

ground_truth.node_text: All production qualification welds within specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all twenty welds meet the specification for current, force, time, and visual appearance.

ground_truth.node_text: All production qualification welds within specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log the electrode data, calibration results and qualification record in the maintenance system.

ground_truth.node_text: Log electrode data, calibration results and qualification record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All data logged and the qualification record has been signed off in the system.

ground_truth.node_text: Log electrode data, calibration results and qualification record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Resistance welding electrode diagnostic and qualification procedure is complete. The machine is now cleared for production operation.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Acknowledged. Procedure complete.
